item.text:
According to the **ResStock 2025 Release 1 Technical Reference**, “Geometry Stories” reports:

- **49%** of housing units are in **one-story buildings** (Table 11, p. 54).
- **Data source:** U.S. EIA **2009 Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) microdata**.
- **Basements are excluded.** Stories count floors above grade; finished attics are included.

[Source: Technical Reference, pp. 54–55](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=55).

There is a documentation discrepancy: the [2025 Release 1 online characteristics page](https://resstock.readthedocs.io/en/2025_release_1/workflow_inputs/characteristics.html#geometry-stories) lists **53%**, whereas the release’s Technical Reference lists **49%**.
